milestones.title: F0 – Architecture and decisions
milestones.description: Approved rights policy, v1 scope, platform/toolchain matrix, API and concurrency decisions. Code requires separate implementation authorization.

milestones.title: F1 – HTTP core
milestones.description: Satisfy selected endpoint, request, response, error, and configuration contracts; deterministic tests and real platform CI.

milestones.title: F2 – Production hardening and v1 gate
milestones.description: Privacy/logging, cancellation, authentication hooks, security review, DocC, and a documented release gate. Release v1 only after every approved core criterion is met.

milestones.title: F3 – Resilience and extensions
milestones.description: Explicitly selected retry/cache/authentication/monitoring/performance modules with policy and concurrency tests.

milestones.title: F4 – File transfers
milestones.description: Upload/download/progress/cleanup and documented per-platform background limitations.

milestones.title: F5 – Real-time communication
milestones.description: Verified WebSocket state, backpressure, reconnect, authentication, and shutdown.

milestones.title: F6 – Specialized features and research
milestones.description: Only for approved product needs, with technical validation, entitlements, and separate security review.

issues.title: [DEC-01] Set minimum OS versions and the Swift/Xcode/SDK baseline
issues.body:
## Purpose

Define the iOS/iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS matrix; explicitly decide visionOS support. Verify concrete APIs against the selected SDK.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Alternatives and consequences documented in an ADR.
- [ ] Owner approval recorded for the decision.
- [ ] Affected roadmap, requirements, and risks updated.
- [ ] No implementation code added.

## Dependencies

F0 cannot close before this decision. Coordinate with the other DEC issues.

issues.title: [NK-01] HTTP and requests
issues.body:
## Source and scope

Specification v1.0, §4.1. Classification: CORE.

Methods, bodies, headers, cookies, redirects, timeouts, cancellation, priority, raw requests, and interceptors.

This is a domain epic, not a Ready implementation task. Domain classification does not automatically select every subrequirement; explicitly include or defer each one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Decompose §4.1 into stable NK-01-XX requirements and separate issues.
- [ ] Approve included/deferred scope and rationale.
- [ ] Document input/output, errors, cancellation, privacy, and platform support for selected requirements.
- [ ] After implementation authorization, approve implementation and deterministic normal/error-path tests.
- [ ] Document DocC, availability, and applicable entitlement/server requirements.
- [ ] Close the epic only when selected requirements are delivered with evidence; planning alone is not delivery.

## Dependencies

DEC-01–DEC-07 and explicit implementation authorization.

## Verification

Link subtasks, ADRs, PRs, and actual test/review evidence upon delivery. No product support has been verified.
